definition: a person who is mentally ill or behaves in a wildly foolish way
hook: We call someone a lunatic and think nothing of it. The word is an accusation about the sky.
modernAnchor: He drives like a lunatic. She has some lunatic plan. We mean reckless, unhinged, out of control.
journey: For centuries, doctors believed madness rose and fell with the moon, like a tide on the mind.
The Latin luna meant moon. Lunaticus described anyone whose sanity seemed to wax and wane with it.
English borrowed the word in the 1200s. A lunatic was not just mad - they were moon-mad.
We kept the insult and forgot the theory. Every lunatic is still quietly blamed on the moon.
